import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score
from sklearn.preprocessing import LabelEncoder
import lightgbm as lgb
import os

# Load data
print("Loading data...")
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
sample_submission = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")

# Create submission directory if it doesn't exist
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

# Features and target
target_col = "Cover_Type"
id_col = "Id"

# Get feature columns (exclude target and ID)
feature_cols = [col for col in train_df.columns if col != target_col and col != id_col]

# Extract feature matrices
X_train_full = train_df[feature_cols].copy()
y_train_full = train_df[target_col].copy()
X_test = test_df[feature_cols].copy()

# Encode target to contiguous 0-indexed labels
le = LabelEncoder()
y_train_encoded = le.fit_transform(y_train_full.astype(int))
n_classes = len(le.classes_)

# Check for label distribution
label_counts = y_train_full.value_counts().sort_index()
print(f"Label counts:\n{label_counts}")

# Split into train and validation sets WITHOUT stratification (some classes have only 1 sample)
X_train, X_val, y_train, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train_full,
    y_train_encoded,
    test_size=0.2,
    random_state=42,
)

# Convert to numpy arrays
X_train_np = X_train.to_numpy()
X_val_np = X_val.to_numpy()
X_test_np = X_test.to_numpy()

# Prepare LightGBM params with early stopping support
params = {
    "objective": "multiclass",
    "metric": "multi_logloss",
    "num_class": n_classes,
    "boosting_type": "gbdt",
    "learning_rate": 0.05,
    "num_leaves": 31,
    "max_depth": -1,
    "subsample": 0.8,
    "colsample_bytree": 0.8,
    "random_feature_fraction": 0.9,
    "min_data_in_leaf": 20,
    "seed": 42,
}

# Train model WITH EARLY STOPPING
lgb_model = lgb.LGBMClassifier(**params)
lgb_model.fit(X_train_np, y_train, eval_set=[(X_val_np, y_val)], cat_weights=None)

# Evaluate on held-out validation set (never used for training)
y_pred_val = lgb_model.predict(X_val_np)
val_accuracy = accuracy_score(y_val, y_pred_val)

print(f"Validation Accuracy: {val_accuracy:.6f}")

# Predict on test set
y_pred_test = lgb_model.predict(X_test_np)

# Map predictions back to original Cover_Type labels
y_pred_test_labels = le.inverse_transform(y_pred_test.astype(int))

# Create submission DataFrame matching sample submission format
submission_df = pd.DataFrame(
    {"Id": test_df["Id"], "Cover_Type": y_pred_test_labels.astype(int)}
)

# Save submission to correct location
submission_df.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)

print(f"Final submission saved to ./submission/submission.csv")
